76666-on-the-face-of-the-flood.title: Flood
76666-on-the-face-of-the-flood.creator: Unknown
76666-on-the-face-of-the-flood.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The hut was one of a number scattered about among the trees, for this was a village of wood cutters and raftsmen. But Matvey was the foreman and paymaster, and in virtue of this, his cottage contained two rooms instead of only the solitary apartment which was kitchen, bedroom, and sitting-room, all in one, in the other dwellings.

arxiv-2101-05539.title: Integrative Learning for Population of Dynamic Networks with Covariates
arxiv-2101-05539.creator: Suprateek Kundu, Jin Ming, Joe Nocera, Keith M. McGregor
arxiv-2101-05539.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Suprateek Kundu, Jin Ming, Joe Nocera, Keith M. McGregor. Abstract:
Although there is a rapidly growing literature on dynamic connectivity methods, the primary focus has been on separate network estimation for each individual, which fails to leverage common patterns of information. We propose novel graph-theoretic approaches for estimating a population of dynamic networks that are able to borrow information across multiple heterogeneous samples in an unsupervised manner and guided by covariate information.

arxiv-2112-01669.title: SDSS-IV MaStar: Data-driven Parameter Derivation for the MaStar Stellar Library Journal: The Astronomical Journal
arxiv-2112-01669.creator: Julie Imig, Jon A. Holtzman, Renbin Yan, Daniel Lazarz, Yanping Chen, Lewis Hill, Daniel Thomas, Claudia Maraston, Moire M. K. Prescott, Guy S. Stringfellow, Dmitry Bizyaev, Rachael L. Beaton, Niv Drory
arxiv-2112-01669.description: Abstract The MaNGA Stellar Library (MaStar) is a large collection of high-quality empirical stellar spectra designed to cover all spectral types and ideal for use in the stellar population analysis of galaxies observed in the Mapping Nearby Galaxies at Apache Point Observatory (MaNGA) survey.

arxiv-2207-03514.title: Hypercritical accretion during common envelopes in triples leading to binary black holes in the pair-instability-supernova mass gap
arxiv-2207-03514.creator: Enrique Moreno Méndez, Fabio De Colle, Diego López-Cámara Alejandro Vigna-Gómez
arxiv-2207-03514.description: Abstract Hydrodynamic studies of stellar-mass compact objects (COs) in a common envelope (CE) have shown that the accretion rate onto the CO is a few orders of magnitude below the Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton (BHL) estimate. This is several orders of magnitude above the Eddington limit and above the limit for neutrino-cooled accretion (i.e., hypercritical accretion, or HCA).

arxiv-2211-06343.title: A Secure Future for Open-Source Computational Science and Engineering Journal: Computing in Science & Engineering
arxiv-2211-06343.creator: Reed Milewicz, Jeffrey Carver, Samuel Grayson, Travis Atkison
arxiv-2211-06343.description: Abstract \jvol XX \jnum XX \paper 8 \jmonth Mon J ournalists, public policy analysts, and economists have called attention to the growing importance that high-performance and scientific computing have to national security and industrial leadership. As computing continues to power scientific advances in virtually every discipline, so too does it improve our economic productivity and quality of life.

arxiv-2305-04004.title: Towards a Simple Framework of Skill Transfer Learning for Robotic Ultrasound-guidance Procedures
arxiv-2305-04004.creator: Tsz Yan Leung, Miguel Xochicale
arxiv-2305-04004.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tsz Yan Leung, Miguel Xochicale. In this paper, we present a simple framework of skill transfer learning for robotic ultrasound-guidance procedures. We briefly review challenges in skill transfer learning for robotic ultrasound-guidance procedures. We then identify the need of appropriate sampling techniques, computationally efficient neural networks models that lead to the proposal of a simple framework of skill transfer learning for real-time applications in robotic ultrasound-guidance procedures.

arxiv-2311-16761.title: Transport properties of a half-filled Chern band at the electron and composite fermion phases
arxiv-2311-16761.creator: Ady Stern, Liang Fu
arxiv-2311-16761.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ady Stern, Liang Fu. We consider a half-filled Chern band and its transport properties in two phases that it may form, the electronic Fermi liquid and the composite-fermion Fermi liquid. For weak disorder, we show that the Hall resistivity for the former phase is very small, while for the latter it is close to 2 ​ h / e 2 2h/e^{2} , independent of the distribution of the Berry curvature in the band.

arxiv-2406-16469.title: Evaluating Visual and Cultural Interpretation: The K-Viscuit Benchmark with Human-VLM Collaboration
arxiv-2406-16469.creator: ChaeHun Park Yujin Baek Jaeseok Kim, Yu-Jung Heo Du-Seong Chang Jaegul Choo
arxiv-2406-16469.description: Abstract To create culturally inclusive vision-language models (VLMs), developing a benchmark that tests their ability to address culturally relevant questions is essential. Existing approaches typically rely on human annotators, making the process labor-intensive and creating a cognitive burden in generating diverse questions. To address this, we propose a semi-automated framework for constructing cultural VLM benchmarks, specifically targeting multiple-choice QA.

arxiv-2412-07389.title: Electroelastic guided wave dispersion in piezoelectric plates: spectral methods and laser-ultrasound experiments
arxiv-2412-07389.creator: D. A. Kiefer, G. Watzl, K. Burgholzer, M. Ryzy, C. Grünsteidl
arxiv-2412-07389.description: Abstract Electroelastic waves in piezoelectric media are widely used in sensing and filtering applications. Despite extensive research, computing the guided wave dispersion remains challenging. This paper presents semi-analytical approaches based on spectral methods to efficiently and reliably compute dispersion curves.

arxiv-2502-10848.title: Implicit Neural Representations of Molecular Vector-Valued Functions
arxiv-2502-10848.creator: Jirka Lhotka, Daniel Probst
arxiv-2502-10848.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Molecules have various computational representations, including numerical descriptors, strings, graphs, point clouds, and surfaces. Each representation method enables the application of various machine learning methodologies from linear regression to graph neural networks paired with large language models ( Serra et al. 2001 ; He et al. 2024 ) .

arxiv-2506-17706.title: Quantum 𝔤 ​ 𝔩 \mathfrak{gl} -weight system and its average values
arxiv-2506-17706.creator: Mikhail Zaitsev
arxiv-2506-17706.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mikhail Zaitsev. We present a proof of a recent conjecture due to M. Shapiro, which describes the average value of the universal 𝔤 ​ 𝔩 {\mathfrak{gl}} -weight system on permutations. The proof uses a quantum analogue of the 𝔤 ​ 𝔩 {\mathfrak{gl}} -weight system on Hecke algebras of type A A , which leads to a one-parameter deformation of the average value of the universal 𝔤 ​ 𝔩 {\mathfrak{gl}} -weight system.

arxiv-2506-23118.title: Belief Propagation-based Target Handover in Distributed Integrated Sensing and Communication This work has been supported by the Wallenberg Foundations through the Wallenberg AI, Autonomous Systems and Software Program. This work has been supported by the SNS JU project 6G-DISAC under the EU’s Horiz
arxiv-2506-23118.creator: Liping Bai, Yu Ge, Henk Wymeersch
arxiv-2506-23118.description: Abstract Distributed integrated sensing and communication (DISAC) systems are key enablers for 6G networks, offering the capability to jointly track multiple targets using spatially distributed base stations (BSs). A fundamental challenge in DISAC is the seamless and efficient handover of target tracks between BSs with partially overlapping fields of view, especially in dense and dynamic environments.

arxiv-2509-05603.title: The p p -adic El Zein-Steenbrink-Zucker bifiltered complex of a projective SNCL scheme with a relative SNCD
arxiv-2509-05603.creator: Yukiyoshi Nakkajima
arxiv-2509-05603.description: Abstract Abstract.— Let (S,{\cal I},\gamma) be a p -adic PD-formal family of log points and let S_{0} be an exact closed log subscheme defined by {\cal I} . For a proper SNCL scheme X/S_{0} with a relative SNCD D on X/S_{0} with structural morphism f\colon X\longrightarrow S_{0}\overset{\subset}{\longrightarrow}S , we construct a p -adic bifiltered complex (A((X,D)/S),P^{D},P)\in{\rm D}^{+}{\rm F}^{2}(f^{-1}({\cal O}_{S})) .

arxiv-2511-20771.title: Exploiting Low Scanwidth to Resolve Soft Polytomies Thanks: This paper presents a result from the first author’s master’s thesis (available at https://doi.org/10.14279/depositonce-21448 ), which was supervised by the second author. An extended abstract of this paper was accepted at SOFSEM [ 6 ] .
arxiv-2511-20771.creator: Sebastian Bruchhold, Mathias Weller
arxiv-2511-20771.description: Abstract Phylogenetic networks allow modeling reticulate evolution, capturing events such as hybridization and horizontal gene transfer. A fundamental computational problem in this context is the Tree Containment problem, which asks whether a given phylogenetic network is compatible with a given phylogenetic tree.

arxiv-2601-16903.title: Cosmic ray electron boosted light dark matter: Implications of LZ 2025 data
arxiv-2601-16903.creator: Sk Jeesun ID, Anirban Majumdar ID
arxiv-2601-16903.description: Abstract Current multi-ton detectors put stringent constraints on the GeV-scale galactic dark matter, pushing the allowed cross-section almost towards the neutrino fog, yet remain mostly insensitive to the light dark matter. Cosmic rays can upscatter the non-relativistic halo dark matter particles, making a sub-population of them gain sufficient kinetic energy to be discernible in current direct search experiments.

pmc-10647250.title: Alismol Purified from the Tuber of Alisma orientale Relieves Acute Lung Injury in Mice via Nrf2 Activation
pmc-10647250.creator: Kyun Ha Kim, Soyeon Kim, Min Jung Kwun, Ji Yeon Lee, Sei-Ryang Oh, Jun-Yong Choi, Myungsoo Joo
pmc-10647250.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Since the ethanol extract of Alisma orientale Juzepzuk (EEAO) suppresses lung inflammation by suppressing Nuclear Factor-kappa B (NF-κB) and activating Nuclear Factor Erythroid 2-related Factor 2 (Nrf2), we set out to identify chemicals constituting EEAO that suppress lung inflammation.

pmc-10702452.title: Long-term outcomes of the classic Konno–Rastan procedure in paediatric and adult patients: impact of aortic annulus size on patient outcomes
pmc-10702452.creator: Ahmad Ali Amirghofran, Maryam Salimi, Hooman Kamran, Hamed Bazrafshan, Mohammad Rafati Navaei, Ali Shokrollahi, Elahe Nirooei, Mohammadreza Edraki, Hamid Amoozgar, Gholamhossein Ajami, Hamid Arabi
pmc-10702452.description: OBJECTIVESThe classic Konno–Rastan procedure may yield different outcomes regarding aortic annulus diameters ≤15 mm and larger. Focusing on the effect of the diameter of the aortic annulus, we described the long-term outcomes of our patients.METHODSThe outcomes of paediatric and adult patients who underwent surgery from 2000 to 2021 were studied retrospectively.

pmc-10719153.title: Improving the reliability of measurements in orthopaedics and sports medicine
pmc-10719153.creator: Aleksandra Królikowska, Paweł Reichert, Jon Karlsson, Caroline Mouton, Roland Becker, Robert Prill
pmc-10719153.description: A large space still exists for improving the measurements used in orthopaedics and sports medicine, especially as we face rapid technological progress in devices used for diagnostic or patient monitoring purposes. For a specific measure to be valuable and applicable in clinical practice, its reliability must be established.

pmc-12711991.title: Changes of head circumference and ventricular width in infant hydrocephalus managed with adjustable shunt valves and gravitational assistance—a comparative bi-center study
pmc-12711991.creator: Isabel Fernandes Arroteia, Hans Christoph Bock, Andreas Schaumann, Valentina Pennacchietti, Ahmed El-Garci, Gesa Cohrs, Matthias Schulz, Friederike Knerlich-Lukoschus, Ulrich-Wilhelm Thomale
pmc-12711991.description: ObjectiveCerebrospinal fluid (CSF) drainage via a ventriculoperitoneal shunt remains to be the most common treatment for infantile hydrocephalus. Since head growth is particularly dynamic and susceptible to intracranial pressure changes during the first months of life, shunting can have a considerable impact.

pmc-12712680.title: Changes in patterns of use and perceptions of cannabis among students in Canada: A decade of data from the Canadian Student Alcohol and Drugs Survey
pmc-12712680.creator: Samantha Goodman, Sebastian A Srugo, Emilia Krzeminska, Hanan Abramovici
pmc-12712680.description: IntroductionThe Canadian Student Alcohol and Drugs Survey is a biennial, repeat cross-sectional survey of grade 7–12 students in the Canadian provinces. This study examined cannabis-related behaviours at five timepoints before and after legalization of cannabis for non-medical purposes.MethodsTrends over time were examined using data from 2014–15 to 2023–24 (n = 264,558).

pmc-13079478.title: Comparison of As, Cd, Cu, Fe, and Pb levels in dry cat foods containing different protein sources (poultry, fish, red meat) and in cats consuming these diets
pmc-13079478.creator: Bengü Bilgiç, Duygu Tarhan, Nural Pastacı Özsobacı, Fatma Ateş, Sema Sandıkçı Altunatmaz, Banu Dokuzeylül, Alev Meltem Ercan, Mehmet Erman Or
pmc-13079478.description: Heavy metals are an important source of environmental contamination and can enter the pet food chain through animal-derived protein ingredients and drinking water. Owing to their obligate carnivorous nature and strong reliance on animal-based proteins, cats may be exposed to diet-related potentially toxic metals.

pmc-13086515.title: Functional Outcomes of Treatment of Paediatric Supracondylar Fractures With Open or Closed Reduction and Crossed Kirschner Wire (K-wire) Fixation
pmc-13086515.creator: Mahak Baid, Anirban Chatterjee, Shamik Hait, Jaya V Lal, Sunandan Datta
pmc-13086515.description: Background: Supracondylar fractures of the humerus are a common type of elbow injury in children, and there is ongoing debate about the best method of surgical fixation.Objectives: The aim of this study was to assess the functional outcome of paediatric supracondylar fractures managed using crossed Kirschner wire (K-wire) fixation.Methods: This was a retrospective observational study.

pmc-13172335.title: Systematic reassessment of reported variants in individuals with suspicion of Alport spectrum disorder reveals a high rate of ambiguous results
pmc-13172335.creator: Korbinian M. Riedhammer, Patrick Richthammer, Dominik S. Westphal, Jasmina Ćomić, Roman Günthner, Matthias C. Braunisch, Anja K. Büscher, Hanns-Georg Klein, Stefanie Weber, Julia Hoefele
pmc-13172335.description: “Alport spectrum disorder” describes a phenotypically and genotypically multifaceted disease entity encompassing classic autosomal recessive and X-linked Alport syndrome (AS) but also more heterogenous and typically milder, yet not benign, hematuric phenotypes like autosomal dominant AS, formerly also known as thin basement membrane nephropathy (TBMN).

pmc-13290280.title: Extracellular vesicle cargo dynamics in the bone marrow microenvironment: from hematopoietic homeostasis to malignant transformation
pmc-13290280.creator: Federica Zanotti, Ayşegül Erdem, Claudia Morganti, Massimo Bonora, Haruhito Totani, Takahisa Nakamura, Keisuke Ito
pmc-13290280.description: The bone marrow (BM) microenvironment relies on extracellular vesicle (EV)-mediated communication to maintain hematopoietic homeostasis and contribute to cellular responses in malignant transformation. EV function as molecular shuttles carrying miRNAs, proteins, and lipids that regulate hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) self-renewal, quiescence, and lineage commitment.

pmc-13700358.creator: Jaouad Nguadi, Hicham Bouzelmat, Mehdi Guedira, Damien Poindron, Nicolas Lellouche, Zouhair Lakhal, Aatif Benyass, Cyrus Moini
pmc-13700358.description: d medical therapy. Biatrial 3-dimensional (3D) mapping-guided cardioneuroablation is an effective pacemaker-sparing strategy in adolescents with refractory cardioinhibitory vasovagal syncope after failure of optimized medical therapy. ▪Dual-modality objective phenotyping (spontaneous 12-second asystole on implantable loop recorder [ILR] plus 9-second asystole on tilt-table testing, VASIS 2B) strengthens patient selection and procedural justification.
